headline: Cloverleaf Mechanical (Cloverleaf Heating, Air & Plumbing), Springfield, OH
summary: Cloverleaf Mechanical LLC is a heating and cooling contractor at 1230 Mitchell Blvd. in Springfield (Clark County), Ohio, that now markets itself as Cloverleaf Heating, Air & Plumbing. The Ohio Construction Industry Licensing Board roster we downloaded on October 22, 2026 shows its HVAC contractor license, HV.22959, as active through March 31, 2027, with Ronald E. Hovda as the license holder.

The company's site says ownership changed in August 2025, when Jonathon, whose family has run SouthTowne Plumbing, took over and added plumbing to Cloverleaf's HVAC work. That may be why older listings show a different phone number and why some directories have flagged the business. The details below sort out which records are current.

headline: Korrect Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning: Dayton HVAC and plumbing since 1950
summary: Korrect Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning, Inc. is a family-owned heating, cooling, plumbing and drain company on West Third Street in Dayton, with a second office in Troy. Its site says it has served Dayton since 1950 and is now in its fourth generation. The Ohio Construction Industry Licensing Board roster we downloaded on October 22, 2026 lists two active HVAC contractor licenses and one active plumbing contractor license under the company name, and it is on the City of Dayton Registered Heating Contractors list (registration 902).

On the heating and cooling side it lists furnaces, boilers, heat pumps, rooftop units, ductless mini-splits, AC repair and installation, indoor air quality and a maintenance plan. It says its technicians are not paid on commission and that 24/7 emergency service has no surge pricing. HVACLists lists it on 85 heating and cooling pages across the Miami Valley, linked below.
